title: Sensitivity Scaling and Limits of Cavity Enhancement in Miniaturized Optically Pumped Magnetometers
summary: The sensitivity of miniaturized optically pumped magnetometers (OPMs) is limited by weak atom-light coupling, which an optical cavity can enhance. In this work, we model the photon-shot-noise-limited sensitivity of cavity-enhanced OPMs in the regime of strongly collisionally broadened optical transitions, characteristic of buffer-gas-filled miniaturized vapor cells. The cavity enhancement is benchmarked against a single-pass free-induction-decay OPM employing Faraday-rotation readout, with the probe power and detuning jointly optimized using the Cramér-Rao lower bound as a figure of merit.…
